findings.title: Payment Terms and Schedule
findings.rationale: The evidence provides specific details regarding the payment terms and schedule under the agreement, including invoicing frequency and payment deadlines.
evidence_excerpts:
3.3 Payment Terms:
Standard credit period: 30 calendar days from invoice date.
Late payment penalty: 1.5% per month on overdue amounts.
Advance payments will not exceed 20% of total PO unless mutually agreed in writing.

findings.title: Late Payment Penalty
findings.rationale: The contract specifies a penalty for late payments, which directly addresses the topic of late payment penalties.
evidence_excerpts: Late payment penalty: 1.5% per month on overdue amounts.

findings.title: Pricing Structure and Billing Schedule
findings.rationale: The evidence provides a detailed description of the pricing structure and billing schedule, including standard billing practices, payment terms, and invoicing details.
evidence_excerpts:
3. Billing Schedule & Frequency
3.1 Standard Billing:
Monthly Invoicing: For ongoing supply contracts, invoices will be raised on the last business day of each month.
Delivery-Based Billing: For one-time supply orders exceeding INR 5,00,000, invoices will be issued upon confirmed delivery to the Client’s site(s).

findings.title: Termination for Convenience Notice Period
findings.rationale: The contract specifies the notice period required for termination without cause.
evidence_excerpts: Either party may terminate the agreement with 30 days’ notice, without affecting outstanding invoices or milestones.

findings.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly states the governing law and the method for resolving disputes.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. Disputes will be under the jurisdiction of courts located in [City, State].

findings.title: Scope of Work Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the scope of work and deliverables under the agreement, specifying the hardware components and associated services to be provided.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement covers the supply of: Hardware components including servers, storage arrays, networking devices, and electronic peripherals. Multi-site deliveries for BFSI branch rollouts. Associated services including installation, testing, and warranty support.

findings.title: Vendor's Service Level Commitments
findings.rationale: The vendor commits to deliver goods as per the specifications and timelines mentioned in the purchase order (PO) and to notify the client of any deviations in the delivery schedule at least 7 business days in advance.
evidence_excerpts: Deliver goods as per the specifications and timelines mentioned in the PO. Notify the Client of any deviations in delivery schedule at least 7 business days in advance.

findings.title: Client Obligations for Vendor Performance
findings.rationale: The evidence outlines specific obligations of the Client that the Vendor relies on for performance, including timely processing of invoices and providing access for installation and testing.
evidence_excerpts:
6. Obligations of Client
Process invoices within the agreed payment timeline.
Notify the Vendor of any discrepancies in invoices or deliveries within 7 business days.
Approve milestone payments and site acceptance certificates promptly to avoid revenue delays.
Provide access to sites for installation and testing activities.

findings.title: Service Performance Reporting
findings.rationale: The agreement specifies that the Vendor shall provide monthly revenue tracking reports detailing billed, unbilled, and pending payments, which indicates how service performance is measured and reported.
evidence_excerpts: Vendor shall provide monthly revenue tracking reports detailing billed, unbilled, and pending payments.
